units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: H3 video for every clip, full sheets and close-ups reviewed. Idle v1 checks the winch and loops back. Move v1: one gait cycle. Attack v1 rams the crossbow out; video 31-32 (smeared crossbow) and 36-39 (a spark spray from the crossbow, not wanted on a bash) are cut, contact at the full extension. Ranged v1 spans the winch, aims and releases; video 62-70 (muzzle glow, painted bolt and speed streaks) are cut because the battle draws its own projectile, contact on the first frame after release. Hit v1 starts rocked back and recovers by video 27; the plate pulsed from 41, after the recovery. Defend v1: crouch behind the raised stock, held. Cast v1: a raised-hand signal to the crew, no spell. Death v1 kneels and falls forward onto the crossbow to a still corpse.
